content: Vite + vite-plugin-pwa is the standard 2025 PWA stack for simple single-page apps. Next.js adds SSR overhead unnecessary for a PWA. SvelteKit is viable but has a smaller ecosystem. vite-plugin-pwa v1.3.0 uses Workbox under the hood, provides zero-config service worker generation, manifest injection, and autoUpdate/prompt modes. Vite 8.x is current.
